name: Rivanna Trail
description: Explore the Rivanna Trail and its connecting trails around Charlottesville. The Rivanna Trails Foundation maintains maps, trail guidance, and opportunities to help care for the network.

name: Ragged Mountain
description: Wooded trails around Ragged Mountain Reservoir. Check the City’s current information and posted signs for trail access during reservoir work.

name: Saunders–Monticello
description: A winding path and connecting woodland trails near Monticello. The trail manager’s guide includes parking, hours, trail maps, and access rules.

name: Charlottesville trails
description: Explore the City’s parks, greenways, and connecting trails. The City’s trail guide links to park information and official maps.

name: Albemarle County trails
description: Discover trail networks throughout Albemarle County. The County’s trail directory provides official park maps and greenway information.
